description: Find events you can access before selecting one. Returns event rows with names, dates and venues. `brandId` or `set_context` scopes to a brand and its child brands. A `status` filter checks the first 800 events.

brandId.description: Brand ID. Defaults to active brand if set.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return, up to 100.

status.description: Filter by event status (e.g. "published" or "unpublished"); checks the first 800 events.

name: list_events

items.description: The rows returned by this list operation.

title: List events
